LESSON: TRANSFORMATION OF ENERGY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.1: Transformation of Energy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Transformation of Energy
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the sources of energy in the environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify forms of energy in nature
2. classify energy sources into renewable or non- renewable
3. demonstrate simple energy transformations in nature
4. describe safety measures associated with energy transformation
5. appreciate the applications of energy transformation in day-to- day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Transformation of Energy

Teach
• Observe Transformation of Energy in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Transformation of Energy (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Transformation of Energy.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Transformation of Energy.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Transformation of Energy.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify forms of energy in nature
• classify energy sources into renewable or non- renewable
• demonstrate simple energy transformations in nature

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Transformation of Energy.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Transformation of Energy: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the sources of energy in the environment?
2. How is energy transformation applied in day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify forms of energy in nature
• classify energy sources into renewable or non- renewable
• demonstrate simple energy transformations in nature
• describe safety measures associated with energy transformation

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
